title: Asian Chicken or Turkey Garden Salad with chicken/turkey, lettuce, fruit, nuts, no dressing

content.title: About
content.content: The Asian Chicken or Turkey Garden Salad combines tender pieces of chicken or turkey, crisp lettuce, fresh fruit, and nuts. It is served without dressing, allowing the natural flavors of the ingredients to shine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Asian spices often used in such salads include soy sauce, ginger, and sesame.
Chicken and turkey are excellent sources of lean protein, suitable for low‑fat diets.
Fruits (such as apple or mango) add natural sweetness and vitamin C.
Nuts (walnuts, cashews, or almonds) provide crunch and healthy monounsaturated fats.
The lack of dressing makes the dish lighter and lets you control added calories.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Chicken and turkey supply high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Fruit and lettuce provide vitamin C, vitamin K, folate, and potassium, supporting immunity and heart health.

items.title: Healthy fats
items.content: Nuts deliver omega‑3 and omega‑6 fatty acids that promote vascular health.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Lettuce and fruit are high in fiber, aiding digestion and promoting satiety.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: Without dressing and with moderate fruit amounts, the salad is suitable for blood‑glucose control.

items.title: Nut allergy
items.content: Nuts can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: If soy sauce is added, sodium levels may be high; choose low‑sodium versions when possible.

items.title: Meat safety
items.content: Ensure chicken or turkey is fully cooked to avoid food‑borne illness.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the salad chilled. Toss gently before serving and optionally add a splash of lemon juice or a light soy‑based dressing to taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the salad in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. Nuts may lose crunch, so add them just before serving.
